transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, Doctor, I came in because... I keep doing some odd things down at the church. It's a bit hard to explain, but like, I'll be standing by the potluck table, holding a serving spoon up in the air, and I just don't move. I just freeze there. Or I'll stand there folding the exact same stack of napkins over and over again, even while people are standing right there waiting on me. 

It's just strange, and I figured I better come in and see what's going on with me.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or full of energy?

No, I haven't really felt like that. I don't get those big bursts of energy or anything. I just feel pretty normal, except for the freezing up and the repeating things. But no, no real highs or extra energy.
Since you were a child, have you usually had a hard time understanding other people in social situations?

No, not really. I've always gotten along fine with folks. I mean, I can tell when somebody's upset or joking around, things like that. I don't think I've ever had a problem understanding people, even when I was a little girl.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological illness?

No, I haven't. I've always been pretty healthy, really. The doctors haven't ever told me I had any kind of... well, any kind of brain illness or major medical problems. Just regular old age stuff, I suppose, but nothing like what you're asking about.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can't hear?
No, I haven't heard any voices like that. Just the regular sounds around the house, you know? Nothing out of the ordinary or anything that other folks wouldn't hear.
Do you believe that someone or something is controlling your movements?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I'm the one moving my own arms and legs, just like always. Nobody's making me do it.
Have you had a period of at least a month when these freezing or repetitive behaviors were happening regularly?

Well, yes, it's been longer than a month. I suppose... well, the odd behavior and all, and people telling me my talking gets hard to follow sometimes... it's been noticeable for about the past six months now.

latest_inference.note: Persistent catatonic behaviors for ~6 months plus disorganized speech ('talking gets hard to follow') support schizophrenia, catatonic type. No medical/neurological illness was reported, making organic catatonic disorder less likely.

There is also evidence of disorganized speech ('people telling me my talking gets hard to follow sometimes').
